metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
元の本体内の実部品を一体の受け・根元へ再構成し、外付け/仮の組立支台を不要とする候補です。実CADの接触・挿入・断面・全荷重prefixを検査済みですが、現物保持力や印刷時サポート不要は未確認です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Existing body material is joined into real seated internal supports, with no external or temporary assembly stands. Native contact/insertion/sections/all nominal load prefixes are checked; physical retention and slicer-support requirements remain unvalidated.

assembly_support.method: Real continuous same-color stepped beam/root modules; unchanged body envelope and 8mm root interfaces, no floor stands.

observations_ja: 修正後copilot-p300-support-free-v2の実53,287部品・196型・0支台を確認。固定分母17,873/目標53,619との差-332は許容内。旧53,350部品の65個を実2個の根元へ統合した差-63で、ダミーで個数を埋めていない。
最初の5根元/199型の試行は、根元間で後続荷重がリセットされるため全体検証で不採用とし、CADと失敗記録を保存した。依存していた4根元を既存同色52部品からの実1solidへ統合し、独立した既存13部品由来の根元は同bytesで再用した。ガードの削除や未知の荷重分担による通過ではない。
統合BS-b5c976590eb22e60は159.8x223.8x9.6mm、271接点。独立BS-5b5d111eea7101eaは47.8x223.8x9.6mm、84接点。個別公称P1S余白内で、元占有セル・全色・非変更部品pose・外形を維持し、床柱や重りは追加していない。
両根元は真のbodybottomZ16.0mmを保持し、受け側stageZ20.8/course5で取付ける。統合側は受けcourse3/4の後のstep571、独立側は受けcourse4の後のstep573。実動画75/76/77/78で周辺工程を閲覧し、Z値を偽装していない。
実native単一solid・接触/bearing・非干渉・挿入・全support/insertion先行関係と、元/別展開FreeCAD全53,287ID/type/color/pose/stepが一致する。実CAD静モーメントの最小余裕は37.063841/16.116248mm、全131/25prefixで1mm基準を維持した。
X/Yと局所Z4.8の実段差neckを含む47/33断面を検査し、最小面積102.525686/52.588563mm²と屋根1.6mmを確認。両方2slicesなのでZ-neckは実在し、REQUIRED_AND_MEASUREDとして証拠に結合した。

support-load-ledger.jsonは元53,350source所属を一回ずつ、実2rootのBRep体積/重心と130/24payload・131/25prefixの実step順を照合した。forbidden_root_encounters=[]。exclusive-root伝播とfirst shared receiverの境界を明記し、単なる祖先rootを禁止しない。共有receiverの各局所最悪boundは全体質量の和として扱わない。
実CG4枚と144frame/12fps/12秒/3章の実動画frame1/18/54/73/108/144、根元75/76/77/78を閲覧。顔・ゴーグル・色と輪郭を保ち、旧2支台は存在しない。保存scene全53,287instance/196native mesh、材質/pose/step、絶対放射復帰と本体0→全数も一致した。
原本の旧18caseと2524native filesは不変、既固定の他3改訂案を再生成していない。現物PLA/infillの質量・保持力・曲げ・クリープ・転倒・手のアクセス・スライサーのサポート要否は未検証。外観採用・印刷は保留。
observations_en: The repaired copilot-p300-support-free-v2 has53,287actual pieces/196types/zero aids. The fixed17,873denominator and53,619target are unchanged; difference-332 is within tolerance. Sixty-five original parts become two real roots, reducing the old53,350count by63 without dummy fillers.

The first five-root/199type attempt was rejected when the whole-case check detected downstream load resets between roots; its CAD and failure evidence are retained. Four dependent roots were physically joined from52existing same-color parts. The independent root from13original parts reuses exact native bytes. No guard removal or assumed unknown load sharing was used.

Merged BS-b5c976590eb22e60 measures159.8x223.8x9.6mm with271contacts; independent BS-5b5d111eea7101ea is47.8x223.8x9.6mm with84contacts. Both remain within nominal per-part P1S margins. Source occupied cells/colors/unaffected poses/envelope are preserved; no floor pillar or ballast is added.

Both retain physical body-bottomZ16.0mm and install at receiverstageZ20.8/course5. The merged root follows receivercourses3/4 atstep571; the independent root followscourse4 atstep573. Actual movie frames75-78 were inspected; physical Z is not falsified.

Actual native single-solid/contact/bearing/noninterference/insertion and every support/insertion predecessor check pass. Original and relocated FreeCAD match all53,287IDs/types/colors/poses/steps. Native static minima37.063841/16.116248mm pass every131/25prefix while retaining the1mm threshold.

Forty-seven/thirty-three real sections cover X/Yand the actual localZ4.8step neck, with minima102.525686/52.588563mm2 and1.6mm roof. Both roots have two slices, so Z-necks are real and bound as REQUIRED_AND_MEASURED.

The source-bound support-load-ledger.json verifies all53,350original memberships exactly once, two real root volumes/centroids,130/24payloads and131/25prefixes in actual step order, with no forbidden root encounter. It specifies exclusive-root propagation and the first-shared receiver boundary, not an arbitrary-ancestor ban. Separate conservative local shared-receiver bounds are not summed as global physical mass.

All four actual CG views,144-frame/12fps/12-second/three-chapter movie samples1/18/54/73/108/144 and root samples75/76/77/78 were inspected. Face/goggles/colors/silhouette remain and both old stands are absent. Saved scene53,287instances/196native meshes, materials/poses/steps, absolute radial return and empty-to-full motion match.

The old18cases/2524native files and the other three fixed revisions are unchanged. Physical PLA/infill mass, retention, bending, creep, tipping, hand access and slicer-support needs remain untested. Visual selection and printing remain on hold.
